استغنين (form X)
# اِسْتَغْنَيْنَ (istaḡnayna) /is.taɣ.naj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
# اُسْتُغْنِينَ (ustuḡnīna) /us.tuɣ.niː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
# اِسْتَغْنِينَ (istaḡnīna) /is.taɣ.niː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
